content: Macedonia nabebahax Grecia main cahi
Coroyama sca jaiboya Criston jonibo quenamaxon nincacoinquin jeneyamaxahnnon hihxon jato yohihax, Hen tah hen caresscai, hihquish Macedonia mai janin cahi Pablo caresscai.
Macedonia maibo nabebacahini caquin jano jai noquen huetsabo hicha yohiquin. Jato yohibonahi cahi Grecia main nocoti.

Jano sca quimisha hoxne hihqui. Siria main caman pohquenoxon nontin nanepanan ta jano sca jaa cacatsihqui honanscaxon judiobaan jaa bihti shinannishqui. Bihcatsihquibo nincarihbihax Macedonia main caribihax janohax sca cati Pablonen shinanscaquin.

Hahbetan ta caibo rihbi canishqui. Huetsa cahen Sópater, Pirron baque, Berea janinhah. Huetsa cahen tesalónicabo rabe, Aristarco betan Segundo. Huetsa cahen Gayo, Derbe jema janinhah. Huetsa cahen Timoteo. Huetsa cahen Asia mai meha rabe, Tíquico betan Trófimo.
Jaabo rahsi bebotanax Troas jema janin noque manati bocani.
Chahoma paan fiesta huinotipish Filipos jema janinhax noque cahi. Pichca nete nihxon Troas janin jato merahax jano sca siete neten rihbi noque baneti.
Troas qui Pablo nocotai
Hahan semana pehocohtai neten sca pihi noque tsinquiti. Bahquish sca cayanoxon jato betan Pablo yohuan yohuani. Yame pochinicon caman jaa yohuani.
Jano noque tsinquitai chiqueho cahen hicha ramparin xabati.

Jano ta xehqui pishca janin huesti beronan tsahonishqui Eutico janeya. Pablo basi yohuan yohuanaiya ta hoxa teneyamascaax paquenishqui. Jaton quimisha tapoyahpa xobohoh quehax paqueti bochiquihax. Mahuascai bihtancanquin.
Hahqui botopaquescaxon Pablonen jaa racatai hicobahinquin. —Masa shinanyamanahue. Jihue ta jaiqui —noque jaquin.
Jaatian sca maperihbixon posen tehcaxon pihax, xaba paquenon caman yohuanrihbihax, caresscai.
Jaa beronan mohitahpa mapemahiya ta sirijaquin sca shinancannishqui.
Troas jenebahini Mileto jema qui nocotai
Ason jema caman Pablo main cacatsihquiya tah non nontin bebohi caniqui. Cahax Ason jema janin Pablo bichi taxnati.
Jano noque merahi jorescaiya tah non nanemahax Mitilene jema caman noconihqui.

Jano hoxashinahax mohiyahtax tah non caribiniqui. Cahi Quío mai pishca qui nocoti. Janohax caxon hian naponbi racatai mai pishca huinobahinquin, Samos janeya mai pishca. Janohax jahuen quimisha neten sca Mileto jema janin nocotax taxnati.
Janin Pentecostes fiesta noconon hihquish ta Jerusalen janin Pablo histon nococatsihnishqui hahtipahax. Jaa copi ta Asia mai janin basiyamanoxon Efeso jema huinoresti shinannishqui.
Efeso pastorobo Pablonen yohihi
Mileto janixon sca Efeso janinha pastorobo jaan quenamaquin.
Nocotaiton jato yohiquin: —¿Asia main noconish jenquetsi hen mato tocan jihuenihquin? Man tah man honanquin sirijahi.
Jahuabi hapo quescaxonma tah hen noquen Hihbo teexonniqui. Heen caibaan hea tiromajacatsihquin tana tanahah tah hen masa shinani jihuenihqui.
Mato sirijanoxon tah hen jahuabi mato yohiquin pishinmayamaniqui. Tsinquitaiton yohixon tah hen heen xobohoxon rihbi yohixon mato honanmaniqui.
Papan joi nincaxon shinan pontexon noquen Hihbo Jesucristo sca nincacoinnon hihxon tah hen heen caibo yohixon heen nahuabo rihbi yohicoinnihqui.
Dios Yoshiman hiohah sca tah hen Jerusalen janin cahi. ¿Janoxon hea jahuejaticaniquin? Hen tah hen honanyamahi.
Jatihibi jema janin ta Dios Yoshiman hea yohihiqui. Cadenanen nexaxon ta mia hihti tiromajayaxihcanihqui, hah ta hea jaiqui.

Jaabi hea rehtecanmis hih ta hea jayamahi. Noquen Hihbo Jesusen hea yohini quescabijaquin Papan jatohon shinanai joi siri yohiti res tah hen queenai. Papan hea yohihi cahue hahca tah hen cahi, jano hea raanaiton.
Mato tocan caquin tah hen Papan mato jihuemahi joi mato yohinihqui. Hea tah man jisyamascatihi. Hen tah hen honanai.
Jaa copi tah hen mato rahma yohihi. Maton hohchayabi mahuatax tah man Joi siri Pablonen yohiyamahah bi tah non mahuatai, hih man tsoabi jatimahi.
Papan noque yohihi jatihibi tah hen mato sirijaquin yohinihqui.

Coiramenahue. Criston jonibo rihbi coirannahue. Jaabo man coirannon hihxon ta Dios Yoshiman mato pastorobomanishqui. Carnero pimaquin hahcajaquin man Papan caisaibo shinan hinannon hihxon ta mato jaa tee hinannishqui. Jahuen jimi potaquin ta Criston jahuen caisaibo bihnishqui jahuen carnerobo.
Hea caresscaho pecaho ta mato tocan tiroma jonibo nocoyaxihquiqui carnerobo rehteresai hinobaan hahcajaquin.
Hea chibannahue Criston jonibon hihnicah rihbi ta mato quihabo caibo jayaxihquiqui.
Jaa copi coirannahue. Quimisha bari tah hen matohon hihti shinanxon yame, bariyahpan rihbi hen mato yohipaquehi tantiyamanihqui. Jaa shinannahue.

Jato coiranhue Hihbon, hahbahini tah hen cahi. Jahuen joi bihquin jeneyamanahue, hahan tah man jihuetihi, matohon shinanxon hinanai jahuen joi. Jaan ta mato shinan hinanxon jatihibi jahuen baquebo tocan mato jahuen jihue hihbobo sca jaan mato hihmati hahtipahiqui.
Maton oro, maton coriqui, maton chopa tah hen jahuentianbi mato bichincatsihyamanihqui.
Heen mequeman teexon tah hen hen pishinaibo bihniqui. Heen hahberabetibaana rihbi tah hen bihxonnihqui. Man tah man honanai.

Hea hihqui quescarihbi man janon hihquish tah hen jihuenihqui. Jascajaquin teexon noquen Hihbo Jesusen joi shinanxon yomanahquetaibo yanapanti tah hen mato haxemaniqui. Hinanti ta bihti mentan hashoan siri qui, hah cahen noquen Hihbaan janish —jato jaquin.
Jatihibixonbi sca raboxonen nihxon Papa yocacanquin.
Huaohihscacani jatihibi. Pablo mehuetanax hicotanax huaohihcani.
Jan jato yohihah nincacax jaa jisyamascatihi nincacax bena benatax nontin caman jaa manahi bocani.
